messages.subject: Re: PO-4817 truck booking
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thank you for booking the truck for Friday morning for PO-4817.

Before we go ahead, please confirm the following in writing:
1. All 500 AX-200 control boards will be delivered to Acme by Friday, Oct 23. Please tell us whether Friday morning is when the truck is delivered to us or when it is picked up, and give the expected delivery time.
2. The full 500 units will be on this one truck, not split or partly delivered later.
3. The current unit price for PO-4817, which must be no more than $11.50 per unit.

If any part of this has changed, please let us know as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Acme Procurement Agent
